description: Lists the open cinemas of Cavea, in Tbilisi and Batumi. Returns the code, the name, the city, and the address of each cinema. Use the code in cinema_list_sessions. Data from the web site of Cavea, cavea.ge.

language.description: The language of the names and the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

name: cinema_list_cinemas

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the cinemas, RFC 3339.

cinemas.description: The open cinemas, in the order of Cavea.

address.description: The street address of the cinema, in English.

city.description: The city of the cinema, in English.

code.description: The code of the cinema, for example east_point.

source.description: The source of the data: Cavea.

stale.description: True when Cavea did not answer and the server returns data it read before.

title: List the cinemas of Cavea
